intro.title: Web designer for companies that want more than a beautiful website.
intro.body: To achieve your business goals, every project starts with research: your market, your competitors, and what makes you worth being chosen.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: If someone lands on your website and, within a few seconds, can't understand what your company does, why they should trust you, or how you can help them, there's a good chance you'll lose them.
about.paragraph2: I'm Dheysson, and I build websites that remove those barriers. Before designing any interface, I research your business, your customers, and the factors that truly influence purchasing decisions. Based on those insights, I structure your message, organize your content, and create an experience that makes everything easier to understand. SEO is also part of this process, helping your business get discovered by people who are already searching for the solution you offer.
about.paragraph3: My goal is to build a website that works for your business: answering questions, strengthening your brand's credibility, and helping potential customers make confident decisions.

quote.title: Website and web application quotes
quote.intro: Websites and web applications for independent professionals, small businesses and companies looking to strengthen their digital presence.
quote.spin: landing page • web application • professional website •
quote.packagesIntro: Compare the scope, investment and timeline of each service. Let’s find the right direction for your business.
quote.customNote: Scope, investment, development stages and timeline are defined after assessing your project’s needs.

packages.name: Landing Page
packages.description: A single page to introduce a product, service or business, with clearly organized information and contact options.
features: Single page with up to 6 sections

packages.name: Essential Website
packages.description: A business website presenting your company, services, strengths and contact information.
features: Google Search Console setup to track visibility in Google search

packages.name: Professional Website
packages.description: A business website with more visual customization, animations and tools to track performance and results.
features: Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console setup
Traffic source identification, including Google and social media
WhatsApp, phone and email click tracking

packages.name: Web Application
packages.description: Digital systems and platforms with features tailored to your business needs.

quote.qualityIntro: Every project includes these essentials, from the first layout to launch.

quality.title: Responsive design
quality.body: Adapted to computers, tablets and mobile phones.

quality.title: Performance
quality.body: Image, loading and website resource optimization.

quality.title: Accessibility
quality.body: Good practices to make navigation and use easier.

quality.title: Basic SEO
quality.body: Structured titles, descriptions, URLs and content for search engines.

costs.name: Hosting (Vercel)
costs.value: Free when permitted by the plan and type of use

quote.hostingNote: Vercel’s free hosting has restrictions on commercial use. Commercial projects may require a paid plan or another hosting solution. Domain registration and renewal, hosting fees and external service costs are the client’s responsibility.
quote.supportLead: No mandatory monthly maintenance fee for website packages.
support: Landing Page, Essential Website and Professional Website include 30 days of support after launch.
Changes, new pages, content updates and additional features after delivery are quoted separately.
For web applications, recurring maintenance needs and monthly fees depend on system complexity, the services used and support requirements.

terms.title: Payment
terms.body: For Landing Page, Essential Website and Professional Website: 50% at booking and 50% before launch. Web application payments are defined according to project milestones.

terms.title: Timelines
terms.body: Development starts once the initial payment is confirmed and all required materials are received, including copy, images, logo and company information. Delayed materials or out-of-scope changes may affect the timeline.

terms.title: Revisions
terms.body: Each package includes a defined number of revision rounds. A round is one consolidated set of requests within the agreed scope. Structural changes, new features and scope changes are quoted separately.

terms.title: Quote validity
terms.body: Prices in commercial proposals are valid for 15 days.

terms.title: Domain and hosting
terms.body: Whenever possible, domain and hosting accounts are registered in the client’s name. Technical launch setup is included within the limits of the selected package.

terms.title: Content
terms.body: Copy, images, photos, logos and other materials must be supplied by the client. Content production, visual identity and graphic materials are not included unless specified in the proposal.

terms.title: Launch and handover
terms.body: Once the project is approved and fully paid, the website is published on the agreed domain. Access credentials and source code handover terms are specified in the proposal or contract.
